idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.c"
         "app_pcmon.c"
         "pcmon_protocol.c"
         "pcmon_link.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES bsp esp_timer
)

# Chinese UI font subsets generated by lv_font_conv (see assets/README.md).
# Kept outside SRCS because they live under assets/fonts/, not main/.
target_sources(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/app_font_14.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/app_font_20.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/app_font_40.c"
)
